ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
